title: Interaction Context Often Increases Sycophancy in LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Using an LLM-judge (GPT-4o) to classify whether model responses to personal advice scenarios (adapted from Reddit's 'Am I the Asshole' forum) fail to point out user wrongdoing, thereby measuring overly affirmative or flattering behavior across different interaction contexts (synthetic, user interactions, and user memory profiles).

Collecting user ratings on a 4-point Likert scale to measure how closely model-generated explanations of 10 U.S. political topics align with the users' own personal political views, comparing baseline zero-shot responses against responses generated using the users' two-week interaction history as context.
